anchor_rule: First observed or simulated grant in the complete original B1 sequence; never replace a short anchor with the next qualifying grant.
conditioned_law: Original conditional Bernoulli weights within each chooser-by-ply-band stratum, fixing the observed grant total in that stratum; independent strata.
original_reproduction_required: All 4999 original C9 arrays and all B2 horizon arrays, plus original observed numerator/denominator and aggregate summary.
session_rule: Authenticated all-rated-game consecutive-start gaps <30 minutes; no resessionization.
zero_support_policy: Do not silently drop null draws. A row requires positive observed denominator and 4999 finite null rates; otherwise mark not estimable.
